question: What battery-life problems or benefits do iPhone 8 owners report?
answer:
One iPhone 8 owner described the battery life as terrible with constant problems with the phone. [112d9256860e_0]
Another reviewer reported a battery life problem, saying it was terrible at just 3-4 hours. [63dce0a91d39_0]
A reviewer of renewed units said the battery life was under 80% per the settings status report and that one unit stated it needs service. [f361cc48d49f_0]
One owner said the battery life was low and that they had to buy a new battery. [319f0d462701_0]
Another reviewer said the battery needed to be replaced because it wouldn't hold a charge, calling that their only complaint. [680d31d2c44b_0]
In contrast, one reviewer said the battery life was much better than represented by reviews, with plenty of charge for a day unless most of the time is spent on FaceTime or watching Netflix. [fe86c95c4ae5_0]
